sections.title: How it works
sections.body: Nucleotide Transformer v2 represents DNA using an encoder pretrained on multiple species. Encoder-only transformer with 6-mer tokenization, rotary position embeddings and SwiGLU feed-forward layers. The documented inputs are DNA sequences with tokenization determined by 6-mers and individual ambiguous/remainder bases. The output consists of contextual DNA embeddings and masked-token probabilities; downstream tasks need adaptation.

sections.title: Versions and reproducibility
sections.body: Nucleotide Transformer v2 is a family of four checkpoints, of 50M, 100M, 250M and 500M parameters, all pretrained on the multispecies dataset. Facts taken from a model card describe the 50M checkpoint's card. Source conflict retained: the 50M model card describes 1,000-token pretraining, while the official NT-v2 documentation describes 2,048-token capacity. Token and base counts must be stated separately.

facts.label: Training data
facts.value: All v2 checkpoints were pretrained on the multispecies dataset: 300B tokens for the 50M and 100M models and 1T tokens for the 250M and 500M models. The 50M model card reports 850 reference genomes, excluding plants and viruses, and 174B source nucleotides. Source corpus size is distinct from repeated training exposure.
